question: How loud is Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green by TfL's own measurement, and what do our phone measurements add?
norm_question: how loud is liverpool street to bethnal green by tfls own measurement and what do our phone measurements add

answer.text: In FOI-1231-2425, TfL's in-cab measurements recorded 87 dB LAeq eastbound and 86 dB LAeq westbound between Liverpool Street and Bethnal Green, while our uncalibrated phone audio (-18.66 and -18.8 dBFS(A)) gives a NO-GO within-trip contrast (+0.54 dB).

verified_claims.text: In FOI-1231-2425, a TfL FOI case officer reported that in-cab noise measurements taken on 24 June 2024 on the Central line recorded 87 dB LAeq eastbound for Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green and 86 dB LAeq westbound for Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street.

citations.quote:
Please see below the noise levels recorded on the Monday 24
June 2024, these measurements were taken from within the train operator's cab.

verified_claims.text: A secondary press report by Brixton Buzz on 27 January 2026, via JRPass, reported an average noise level of 92.8 decibels for Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green on the Central line.

citations.quote: Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green (Central line) – 92.8 decibels

verified_claims.text: Our uncalibrated relative phone-audio levels for Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green averaged -18.66 dBFS(A) (sd 0.35) across 6 eastbound runs and -18.8 dBFS(A) (sd 0.48) across 5 placement-ok westbound runs, and cannot be compared with TfL's dB figures.

Across 11 placement-ok trips, the mean within-trip difference between Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green and Bethnal Green to Mile End was +0.54 dB ( louder in 10 of 11 trips, range -0.13 to +1.21 dB), yielding a NO-GO verdict because one trip (R10_WB_MLE-LST at -0.13 dB) went the other way, while the GO conditions of a mean of at least 1 dB and every level variant agreeing were also unmet.

Using the NIOSH sound level meter app in the passenger saloon, we recorded indicative whole-trip readings of 91.9 dB(A) LAeq eastbound and 87.3 dB(A) LAeq westbound over one trip per direction between Liverpool Street and Mile End (including platform waits and the Bethnal Green dwell), which may read low because the app is validated only up to about 85 dB(A) and are not like-for-like with TfL's per-section in-cab figures.
